host: PWRunner | Swift; inside the XPC bundle; launchd: XPC service lookup, or a Mach service for BYOXPC; no; none, by the invariance rule; actor-form token custody copies, compares and erases bytes without a sandbox call; one reservation and at most one specimen; unused reservation expiry or abandonment retires the host; terminal reply flush delay 50 milliseconds is best effort All authorized connections share one locked reservation slot. Only the connection holding its grant can consume it, before specimen decoding. Stale expiry or disconnect cannot retire an executing owner; client loss after submission never permits replay.

worker: selected or unentitled C worker | C; inside the XPC bundle; the host; equipment is independent of apply/unapplied; inherited restrictions remain; sandbox_compile_string, params, sandbox_apply; actor sandbox_extension_issue_file, consume and release; one specimen in the single-worker form, or one actor of an actor-form specimen; one application (none for an unapplied actor) and all of its ordered visits; parked between visits; terminal publication exits without host permission

T5: posix_spawn; fd 0 policy pipe, fd 3 shared region, fd 4 ready pipe; optional fd 5 transient token channel | Policy delivery uses nonblocking writes under one absolute monotonic deadline (the worker_policy_transfer limit) beginning after spawn. Expiry closes input and enters cleanup before readiness or sentinel polling. The pipe carries no framing: the host writes the submission's byte count into the shared header before spawn, and the worker at EOF publishes the count it read and refuses a different length before compiling.
T5 posix_spawn; fds 0, 3, 4; optional 5

T17: delivery into the recipient's assigned inbound slot; the parked recipient validates framing and its preassigned source/action/delivery before acknowledging without consuming | Recipient framing acknowledgement precedes host byte equality and usable/failed settlement, then the source answer. Consumption requires committed, accepted, usable settlement. Private custody erases at last declared transfer use, including failed delivery; shared teardown erasure requires a reaped or never-launched owner.
T17 delivery and acknowledgement

T18: sealed equipment binding before spawn; owned live signing inspection after usable setup before activation | Constructed signing observations exercise complete two-role binding, per-actor boolean requirements, explicit fixture provenance, live path mismatch, process association and ownership/deadline refusal. They do not establish native signature validity or effective authority.
T18 sealed equipment binding before spawn; owned live signing inspection after usable setup before activation
